_about: Manual corrections applied on top of wiki.json by scripts/build-data.mjs. Every patch is taken from the same Monster Hunter Wiki page (CC BY-SA) where the automated extraction failed, or maps a wiki value onto this project's vocabulary. 'reason' explains each one.

Gravios.reason: Page uses the 'New Monster Infobox' template, which the extractor did not read. Values transcribed from that infobox; Poison is listed for 6th Gen (Wilds), a main-series game.

Lagiacrus.reason: 'Weakest to' uses a malformed <br/ > tag that broke line splitting. Infobox lists Fire (Earth is a spin-off-only element).

Gore Magala.reason: Wiki lists '???' type (4th-5th Gen) and Demi Elder (Wilds).

Apex Diablos.reason: Infobox 'Weakest to' reads '?'. Kept as unknown rather than guessing.

Green Plesioth.reason: Titles were stored comma-separated in one field. Threat level: MH3U Hunter's Notes: Threat ★★★★★ (own entry).

Rey Dau.reason: Third title contains wiki link markup; only the first two are used.

Abyssal Lagiacrus.reason: Threat level: MH3U Hunter's Notes: Threat ★★★★★★ (own entry).

Dire Miralis.reason: Threat level: MH3U Hunter's Notes: Threat ★★★★★★ (own entry).

Hallowed Jhen Mohran.reason: Threat level: MH3U Hunter's Notes: Threat ★★★★★★ (own entry).

Sand Barioth.reason: Threat level: MH3U Hunter's Notes: Threat ★★★★★ (own entry).

Gaismagorm.reason: Threat level: MH Rise: Sunbreak Hunter's Notes: Threat Level ★×10. Confirmed by two sources.

Savage Deviljho.reason: Threat level: No own entry in MH3U/MH4U/MHGU: the game shows the shared Deviljho entry, Threat ★★★★★★.

Raging Brachydios.reason: Threat level: No own entry in MH4U/MHGU: the game shows the shared Brachydios entry, Threat ★★★★★.

Rusted Kushala Daora.reason: Threat level: No own entry in MH4U: the game shows the shared Kushala Daora entry, Threat ★★★★★★.

Balahara.reason: Threat level removed: the wiki writes the Wilds rating as '★-★★★★★' (a 1–5 range that varies per encounter), which the original import miscounted as 6. Wilds has no fixed per-monster threat level.

Doshaguma.reason: Threat level removed: the wiki writes the Wilds rating as '★-★★★★★' (a 1–5 range that varies per encounter), which the original import miscounted as 6. Wilds has no fixed per-monster threat level.

Nu Udra.reason: Threat level removed: the wiki writes the Wilds rating as '★-★★★★★' (a 1–5 range that varies per encounter), which the original import miscounted as 6. Wilds has no fixed per-monster threat level.

firstAppearanceFallback: When the wiki lead sentence names no game, the earliest main-series game in the monster's game list is used (affects collaboration and Wilds monsters whose lead sentence is phrased differently).
_threatNote: Threat level = the star rating in a game's Hunter's Notes (MH3U, MH4/4U, MHGen/GU, MHRise/Sunbreak). Monster Hunter World/Iceborne has no such rating, and Wilds rates each encounter (1–5 stars) rather than each monster, so monsters only in those games keep threat = null (shown as '?').
